routeAdjustment: The existing lower-coset equivalence gives the p+1 level index directly, avoiding the archived Atkin involution construction. The existing upper transversals prove the level coset map bijective. Native H1 trace and the existing full correspondence coboundary comparison preserve nonzero classes and all good-prime eigenvalues. The original field-producing consumer is assembled through a typed binary-to-character helper within unchanged proof limits.
discharged: Every original primitive form of weight at least two and every prescribed rational prime p supply the genuine local coefficient field and a nonzero native H1 eigensystem for the actual one-dimensional character at a level M with Q|M, p|M and M|Q*p. All original good-prime Fourier reductions equal ell^j times the identity-coefficient character eigenvalues, and e+2*j is congruent to the original binary degree modulo p-1. For p away from Q, actual restriction to Gamma0(Q*p) is injective: its original p+1 coset index and finite trace are proved. The exact original Hecke coset equivalence, subgroup conjugation and native representative coboundary correction prove full good-prime Hecke compatibility. The residue-prime-divisibility premise is removed. No local coefficient field, binary eigenclass, surviving character, nonvanishing, index bound or Hecke comparison is assumed.
remaining: Further character-to-weight-two reduction at a level dividing Q*p^2, geometric residual Galois association, all-weight adic realization, crystallinity and higher symmetric-power continuation remain. Acceptance remains 16/20; DUB-17--20 are open.
